checks: Scope: the page is rebuilt by authoring/evidence/html-css-js/html-and-css/page-build (hc-engine@1, adapted from the landed jb-engine@1 pattern) into the full DESIGN.md guidance anatomy: topic bar with progress segments, closed Objectives disclosure and Restart activity; an Activities timeline; one section per activity with the teaching in the reading region and a Your task, Activity checks, model, control and feedback in the workspace; back links; Previous activity and Continue buttons; one closed Need a hint? disclosure on each of the three practice tasks; data-pep-responsive and data-pep-guidance-contract with the matching qa-paths guidance object. Where this fits is omitted because DESIGN.md says to omit it when no meaningful practitioner choice is presented in a task.

Teaching meaning preserved: an automated comparison against main 5c5eabfa found the TOPIC script byte-identical and every teaching, task, option, data-static-alt and recap string present. Removed strings are engine chrome only (old progress counter, old Restart description, old 'All activities finished' line, region aria-labels, the old no-JavaScript sentence, which is extended). 'the current region/ring has a blue outline' became 'is outlined' because the highlight now uses the violet focus token. Added learner text: Your task headings, Activity checks criteria taken from each task's own 'How to know it is done' line, three hints (a where-to-act target and a next reasoning step drawn from the page's teaching), back links and the navigation labels.

Supported execution and scoring unchanged: predictions stay unscored; the graded apply keeps confidence before feedback, one retry in a second representation, then reveal and settle; credit is issued once per activity and completion needs all five activities. Navigation is now reversible (Previous, timeline and back links) with future activities locked until the current one completes; Restart resets only the current activity's controls, feedback and the TOPIC state that activity changed. The responsive overflow model is shielded from the DESIGN base rules so it still overflows until the learner applies the fixes.

Timing re-measured with the frozen estimator; modeledWorstPath, budget and aboutLabel recomputed under the recorded basis (topic.json). components is now empty because the restart@1 and progress@1 fragments are replaced by the engine.
